note: Hand labels: how the maker on the retail listing relates to the maker on the regulator row. same-company = recognisably the same firm (legal suffix, unit or group name differs). brand-owner = a well-known company that owns the brand while the regulator lists the plant that made it (loan licence / contract manufacturing), so the shop's software shows a different company for the same physical product. unclear = two different small firms; it could be a brand owner or an unrelated product with the same brand name, and only the strip can tell. Labelled by reading the names, before scoring.
